room_rent.note: SI 5L–20L: up to Deluxe room. SI 25L–50L: any room. Proportionate deductions apply on associated medical expenses if higher room chosen. Optional Room Rent Enhancement add-on available to upgrade to any room for SI 5L–20L.

icu.note: ICU charges covered as part of in-patient treatment; no separate sub-limit stated.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned for Elite Plan.

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; Bariatric capped; Rehab/Pain capped
sub_limits.note: Cataract: ₹60,000–₹75,000. Bariatric: ₹2.5L–₹5L. Rehabilitation & Pain Management: up to ₹25,000/yr. Road ambulance: ₹5,000/hosp, ₹10,000/yr. Air ambulance: 10% of SI up to ₹2.5L. Newborn: 10% of SI up to ₹1L.

deductible.note: No inbuilt deductible. Optional aggregate deductible (₹25K/₹50K/₹1L) or per-claim deductible (₹5K/₹10K) available at additional premium with premium discounts.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months for 1-year and 2-year terms; 36 months for 3-year term. No PED buy-back option for Elite Plan.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24 months for 1-year and 2-year terms; 18 months for 3-year term.

maternity.note: Delivery expenses and Assisted Reproduction Treatment not available under Elite Plan. Newborn baby cover available subject to conditions.

cumulative_bonus.note: 50% of SI after first claim-free year; 25% of SI for every subsequent claim-free year; max 150%. Bonus reduced at same rate as accrual on claim. Alternatively, No Claim Discount of 3% (SI 5L–7.5L), 1% (SI 10L–50L) in lieu of CB.

restoration.note: Sum insured reset once per policy year for different/unrelated illness only. Modern treatments and accidents not covered under restoration. Unutilised reset not carried forward.

domiciliary.note: Covered for illness requiring hospitalisation but treated at home for >3 days. Several conditions excluded (asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, etc.).

ayush.note: In-patient AYUSH hospitalisation covered up to sum insured. Yoga & Naturopathy require prior company approval.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor expenses benefit is only available under Signature Plan.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance: up to ₹5,000 per hospitalisation, max ₹10,000 per policy year. Air ambulance: 10% of SI up to ₹2.5L per policy year.

modern_treatments.note: All modern treatments covered up to sum insured under Elite Plan (no sub-limits as in Premier Plan).

consumables.note: Consumables (List I items) available as optional add-on for Elite Plan at additional premium.

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes.

notable_exclusions: No maternity/delivery, no ART/surrogacy, no organ donor expenses, no home care treatment, no hospice care, no sleep disorder cover, restoration for unrelated illness only
optional_riders: Room Rent Enhancement (any room), Consumables, Hospital Cash, Aggregate/Per-claim Deductible, Premium Promise, Personal Accident (AD&PTD)
